image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, submerged in shallow water with aquatic plants and gravel. The turtle's head is extended to the left, showing dark, textured skin. The carapace is domed, dark brown/black with lighter brown scutes, appearing wet and glossy. A watermark text '© C.J.Hutchinson 2013' is visible in the top left corner.
